name: @repo/sync
description: The desktop's account client: SyncAccount (Better Auth over the configured server — email+password, sign-up, social OAuth with a state nonce, password reset, capabilities probe) plus the two ~/.inteligir JsonStores that remember the server URL and the bearer session. Holds no vault state. The system-browser opener is injected (setSyncBrowserOpener) — this package never imports server or electron code.
